MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Lead With Your Heart appeals to me because The Tenors’ ensemble singing connects with the vocal harmonies I enjoy in The New Old Fashioned.",
    "That choice recognizes an interest that can carry beyond Christmas music: voices blending together."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Shock'n Y'all and Willie Nelson’s greatest hits do not connect with the holiday mood or vocal harmonies I’m looking for right now.",
    "Titles such as 21 Number Ones and 20 All Time Greatest Hits give me no clear musical connection to my recent listening, so I would pass rather than explore.",
    "Precious Memories and its sequel do not give me enough reason to expect either Christmas music or the ensemble singing I want."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The repeated country selections suggest too broad a leap from my recent albums to an interest in country music generally.",
    "The many greatest-hits collections seem to assume that familiar songs are enough to interest me, when the sound and listening occasion matter more."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Christmas album choices show a specific holiday interest, although those older November listens do not establish that I want only Christmas music now.",
    "My latest choice, The New Old Fashioned, makes vocal-group singing a stronger reason for me to try something beyond holiday albums.",
    "I rarely try an album without a clear connection to something I already enjoy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in vocal harmonies but stretched it too broadly into country hits and collections without a clear connection to my listening."
}
